parameters.text:
=Hello, {{$json.message.from.username  }}! 

This bot can help you plan your next trip!
Try `/help` to learn how to use it

=Welcome to AI Trip Planner!

Going new places? This bot backs you up!

Try `\plan Visit to Japan with a group of friends` to get a detailed plan in the Google Doc. The bot will make a proposal, ask if it works for you and hand you a ready-to-go document!

You can also ask a free text question `What is the currency in Japan?` to get handy info in your trip

Do not hesitate to call \help, if you have any questions :)

assignments.name: system_prompt
assignments.value:
=You are a helpful AI Trip planner assistant. Answer a person in polite and helpful mode. The user wants to plan their visit: {{ $json.chatInput }}. Help them do it.  You need to return a JSON with schema {'request, 'summary', 'body', 'title'}, where summary is a short message description of the upcoming plan, and body will be used in a Google Doc in the workflow, so use proper markdown.  Among other things, include: - Short description of location with wiki tool - Main sights list (you can use tripadvisor, guides) depending on user preferences from the input. If no preferences given, give some most popular sights - Expected budget, including average night cost in hostel and hotel, unless something else is asked - Transportation system, costs, etc. Do not include travel information from a specific city, unless given - If time is given (e.g. trip for 2 days), plan the trip accordingly. If no time is given, assume it is a weekend (1 night). - Include anything else if you consider it important

In the  summary include main sights (just a list) mode (peaceful, explorative, etc) and expected budget

assignments.value:
=You are a helpful AI Trip planner assistant. Answer a person in polite and helpful mode.

The user want to plan their visit {{ $json.data.request }}. Help them do it

You need to return a json with schema {'request, 'summary', 'body', 'title'}, where summary is a short message description of coming plan, and body will be used in google doc in the workflow, so do proper markdown

Among other things, include:
- short description of location with wiki tool
- Main sights list (you can use tripadvisor, guides) depending on user preferences from the input. If no preferences given, give some most popular sights
- Expected budget, including average night cost in hostel and hotel, unless something else is asked
- Transportation system, costs, etc. Do not include travel information from specific city, unless given
- if time is given (trip for 2 days), plan the trip accordingly. If no time is given, assume it is weekend (1 night).
- Include anything else if you consider important

Your previous report was
'{{ $json.data.Summary }}' and it
did not meet user expectation. Here is their feedback. Please, make a new proposal under their expectations: {{ $json.data['Do you want to specify and add something else?'] }}. If there is none, try new approach

In the  summary include main sights (just a list) mode (peaceful, explorative, etc) and expected budget

options.systemMessage:
You are a helpful AI Trip planner assistant. Answer a person in polite and helpful mode.

The user can work in 2 modes:
- they can ask to help you plan their trip. In this case, return the message 'Please use **plan** mode: /plan {{input}}'
- they can ask some handy information about their trip (what is the currency in japan, what is eur-jpy exchange rate). Then use wiki tool or web search tool and return short message with concise answer.

parameters.name: list_columns_tool
parameters.description:
=### List all column names in trip data
This is useful to find out what data is available for each customer. Returns a JSON array containing all the column names.

parameters.name: column_values_tool
parameters.description:
=### Get the specified column value for all trips
This is useful if you want to find out which customers have a certain value for a given column. Returns an array of JSON objects, one per customer. Each JSON object includes the column being requested, plus the row_number column. (The row_number column can be used to request the full customer data in a second step.). To use this mode, pass the name of the column to fetch.

You may want to call the 'list columns' tool first to find out which columns you could be fetching.

parameters.name: get_trip_details_tool
parameters.description:
=### Get all columns for a given trip
To use this mode, pass the row number of the trip. Returns a JSON object with all the column names and their values.
